title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 28
paragraphs: As time went on, nearly all the peoples on this side of the river Halys had been subdued — for except the Cilicians and Lycians, Croesus had reduced and kept under his rule all the nations, that is to say the Lydians, Phrygians, Mysians, Mariandynians, Chalybes, Paphlagonians, Thynian and Bithynian Thracians, Carians, Ionians, Dorians, Aeolians, and Pamphylians —
